claim.text: 文档描述，ffprobe 可收集多媒体流信息，并以人和机器可读的形式输出，包括容器格式及其中各媒体流的格式和类型。

evidence.quote: ffprobe gathers information from multimedia streams and prints it in human- and machine-readable fashion. For example it can be used to check the format of the container used by a multimedia stream and the format and type of each media stream contained in it.

claim.text: 文档规定，除非另有说明，数值选项可接受带 SI 前缀的数字字符串；前缀后追加 i 表示以 1024 的幂为基础的二进制倍数，追加 B 则将数值乘以 8。
claim.unit: SI 前缀及二进制倍数；B 对应乘数 8
claim.scope: 所给文档中未另行规定的数值选项
claim.caveats: 保留“除非另有说明”的例外；不扩展为对任意参数或实际安装版本的保证。

evidence.quote: All the numerical options, if not specified otherwise, accept a string representing a number as input, which may be followed by one of the SI unit prefixes, for example: ’K’, ’M’, or ’G’. If ’i’ is appended to the SI unit prefix, the complete prefix will be interpreted as a unit prefix for binary multiples, which are based on powers of 1024 instead of powers of 1000. Appending ’B’ to the SI unit prefix multiplies the value by 8.

claim.scope: 通用选项 -sources 的输入设备源列表
